required_raw_fields.stim: optogenetic stimulus channel on the ephys time base

mapping_basis: the pinned import notebook assigns each of the four bilateral a2_d_* aliases the ordered neuron labels ['a2_l', 'a2_r']
the pinned load_sr_matfile_data function maps neuron_labels[0] to data['ephys_A'] and neuron_labels[1] to data['ephys_B']
the same loader reads yaw directly from data['yaw'] and sampling/time bases from ball_SR, t_ball, ephys_SR, and t_ephys

schema_confirmation.rule: all required field names must be present in every authenticated source file before numeric extraction is authorized

allowed_interpretation: pinned secondary-analysis code provides an independent raw-field and left/right channel mapping to compare against the authenticated source-file schema
forbidden_interpretation: field-map authority alone proves the local source bytes have the expected schema
field-map authority computes or validates the Figure 3C statistic
secondary labels a2_l/a2_r may be remapped after seeing navigation performance
ephys_A/ephys_B laterality may be swapped to improve a downstream result
